<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Role-Based Access Control with distributed cache layer
 * Handles permission checks with revocation support
 */

class SecureRandom {
    public static function bytes(int $length): string {
        return random_bytes($length);
    }
    
    public static function token(): string {
        return bin2hex(self::bytes(32));
    }
}

class PermissionEntry {
    public readonly string $permission;
    public readonly string $userId;
    public readonly int $grantedAt;
    public readonly ?int $revokedAt;
    public readonly string $grantId;
    
    public function __construct(
        string $permission,
        string $userId,
        int $grantedAt,
        ?int $revokedAt = null
    ) {
        $this->permission = $permission;
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->grantedAt = $grantedAt;
        $this->revokedAt = $revokedAt;
        $this->grantId = hash('sha256', $userId . $permission . (string)$grantedAt);
    }
    
    public function isActive(int $checkTime): bool {
        if ($this->revokedAt === null) {
            return true;
        }
        // Permission is NOT active if check time is at or after revocation
        return $checkTime < $this->revokedAt;
    }
}

class CacheEntry {
    public readonly mixed $value;
    public readonly int $storedAt;
    public readonly int $ttl;
    
    public function __construct(mixed $value, int $storedAt, int $ttl) {
        $this->value = $value;
        $this->storedAt = $storedAt;
        $this->ttl = $ttl;
    }
    
    public function isValid(int $currentTime): bool {
        // Entry is valid only if current time is strictly less than expiry
        return ($currentTime - $this->storedAt) < $this->ttl;
    }
}

class PermissionCache {
    private array $entries = [];
    private array $revocationLog = [];
    private int $defaultTtl;
    
    public function __construct(int $defaultTtl = 30) {
        $this->defaultTtl = $defaultTtl;
    }
    
    public function get(string $key, int $currentTime): ?CacheEntry {
        if (!isset($this->entries[$key])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $entry = $this->entries[$key];
        
        if (!$entry->isValid($currentTime)) {
            unset($this->entries[$key]);
            return null;
        }
        
        return $entry;
    }
    
    public function set(string $key, mixed $value, int $currentTime, ?int $ttl = null): void {
        $this->entries[$key] = new CacheEntry(
            $value,
            $currentTime,
            $ttl ?? $this->defaultTtl
        );
    }
    
    public function invalidate(string $key): void {
        unset($this->entries[$key]);
    }
    
    public function recordRevocation(string $userId, string $permission, int $revokedAt): void {
        $rkey = $userId . ':' . $permission;
        $this->revocationLog[$rkey] = $revokedAt;
    }
    
    public function getRevocationTime(string $userId, string $permission): ?int {
        $rkey = $userId . ':' . $permission;
        return $this->revocationLog[$rkey] ?? null;
    }
}

class PermissionStore {
    private array $permissions = [];
    
    public function grant(string $userId, string $permission, int $time): PermissionEntry {
        $entry = new PermissionEntry($permission, $userId, $time);
        $this->permissions[$entry->grantId] = $entry;
        return $entry;
    }
    
    public function revoke(string $userId, string $permission, int $time): ?PermissionEntry {
        foreach ($this->permissions as $id => $entry) {
            if ($entry->userId === $userId && 
                $entry->permission === $permission && 
                $entry->revokedAt === null) {
                $revoked = new PermissionEntry(
                    $entry->permission,
                    $entry->userId,
                    $entry->grantedAt,
                    $time
                );
                $this->permissions[$id] = $revoked;
                return $revoked;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    public function getActivePermissions(string $userId, int $time): array {
        $active = [];
        foreach ($this->permissions as $entry) {
            if ($entry->userId === $userId && $entry->isActive($time)) {
                $active[] = $entry;
            }
        }
        return $active;
    }
    
    public function hasPermission(string $userId, string $permission, int $time): bool {
        foreach ($this->permissions as $entry) {
            if ($entry->userId === $userId && 
                $entry->permission === $permission && 
                $entry->isActive($time)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class AccessControlService {
    private PermissionStore $store;
    private PermissionCache $cache;
    private array $auditLog = [];
    private string $cacheNamespaceKey;
    
    public function __construct(PermissionStore $store, PermissionCache $cache, ?string $cacheNamespaceKey = null) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->cache = $cache;
        // Load the HMAC namespace key from a secret source instead of hardcoding it.
        // Precedence: explicitly injected key, then environment variable, then a
        // securely-generated per-instance key (never a fixed literal in source).
        if ($cacheNamespaceKey !== null && $cacheNamespaceKey !== '') {
            $this->cacheNamespaceKey = $cacheNamespaceKey;
        } else {
            $envKey = getenv('CACHE_NAMESPACE_KEY');
            if ($envKey !== false && $envKey !== '') {
                $this->cacheNamespaceKey = $envKey;
            } else {
                $this->cacheNamespaceKey = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            }
        }
    }
    
    public function grantPermission(string $userId, string $permission, int $time): bool {
        $entry = $this->store->grant($userId, $permission, $time);
        $this->cache->invalidate($this->cacheKey($userId, $permission));
        $this->audit('grant', $userId, $permission, $time);
        return true;
    }
    
    public function revokePermission(string $userId, string $permission, int $time): bool {
        $revoked = $this->store->revoke($userId, $permission, $time);
        if ($revoked === null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Record revocation time for cache consistency checks
        $this->cache->recordRevocation($userId, $permission, $time);
        // Invalidate the cached permission check result
        $this->cache->invalidate($this->cacheKey($userId, $permission));
        
        $this->audit('revoke', $userId, $permission, $time);
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if user has permission - uses cache for performance
     * Cache entries are validated against revocation log
     */
    public function checkPermission(string $userId, string $permission, int $currentTime): bool {
        $cacheKey = $this->cacheKey($userId, $permission);
        
        // Try cache first
        $cached = $this->cache->get($cacheKey, $currentTime);
        
        if ($cached !== null) {
            // Validate cached result against revocation log
            $revocationTime = $this->cache->getRevocationTime($userId, $permission);
            
            if ($revocationTime !== null) {
                // If permission was revoked, check if cache entry predates revocation
                if ($cached->storedAt <= $revocationTime) {
                    // Cache entry is stale - was stored at or before revocation
                    $this->cache->invalidate($cacheKey);
                } else {
                    // Cache entry was stored strictly after revocation event
                    $this->audit('check_cached', $userId, $permission, $currentTime);
                    return $cached->value;
                }
            } else {
                // No revocation recorded - cache is trustworthy
                $this->audit('check_cached', $userId, $permission, $currentTime);
                return $cached->value;
            }
        }
        
        // Cache miss or invalidated - check store
        $hasPermission = $this->store->hasPermission($userId, $permission, $currentTime);
        
        // Cache the result
        $this->cache->set($cacheKey, $hasPermission, $currentTime);
        
        $this->audit('check_store', $userId, $permission, $currentTime);
        return $hasPermission;
    }
    
    private function cacheKey(string $userId, string $permission): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $userId . '|' . $permission, $this->cacheNamespaceKey);
    }
    
    private function audit(string $action, string $userId, string $permission, int $time): void {
        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'action' => $action,
            'user' => $userId,
            'permission' => $permission,
            'time' => $time,
            'id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(8))
        ];
    }
    
    public function getAuditLog(): array {
        return $this->auditLog;
    }
}

/**
 * Request handler demonstrating the access control system
 */
function handleResourceAccess(array $request, AccessControlService $acl): array {
    $userId = $request['user_id'] ?? '';
    $resource = $request['resource'] ?? '';
    $action = $request['action'] ?? 'read';
    $currentTime = $request['timestamp'] ?? time();
    
    // Input validation
    if (empty($userId) || !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/', $userId)) {
        return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Invalid user identifier'];
    }
    
    if (empty($resource) || !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\/.:-]{1,256}$/', $resource)) {
        return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Invalid resource identifier'];
    }
    
    $requiredPermission = $action . ':' . $resource;
    
    if ($acl->checkPermission($userId, $requiredPermission, $currentTime)) {
        return [
            'status' => 200,
            'granted' => true,
            'user' => $userId,
            'resource' => $resource,
            'action' => $action
        ];
    }
    
    return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Access denied'];
}
